subject: eduscan: build base-aware + prune-aware LinuxTerminal phantom-child heuristic. #104 root-home prune (LinuxTerminal.js:4003) deletes base-seeded /root/* keys a /root overlay doesn't reseed -> phantom (ls shows, cat fails). Verified only da-linux-post-exploitation was affected among 6 root-overlay labs (#205 fixed it); crude non-root scan flagged ~134 candidates but ~98% are FPs (base seeds session-user home dotfiles, non-root not pruned). Need auditor to verify the cross-user/non-root candidate list + make it a permanent gate
